request.subject: UNIT:ICE_FOLK:SWORDSMAN

layers.text: Change the shading of the wool only, so that the animal is lit from the left: the rump, the back and the left half of the body become lighter warm brown wool, colour #8a7560, with a pale highlight along the top left of the back; the chest, the belly and the wool under the head on the right become one tone darker, colour #4a3b30. Do not change any shape or other colour: keep the mane, saddle patch, muzzle, eyes, frost-blue horns, legs, black outline and art style the same, transparent background.
